purpose: Every row on the hosted Preview project that carries data_environment = 'PRODUCTION' and was in fact produced by a certification gate. Activation inserts these into certification_exclusions verbatim; the source rows are never touched.
identification: By EXACT id, enumerated from the database. Never by timestamp range, proximity, deployment guess or row count.
howEnumerated: For each of the 25 public tables carrying a data_environment column, every row with data_environment = 'PRODUCTION' was listed. Seven tables had any. All 14 hosted pursuits are DEMO, so no hosted row records genuine production activity and the PRODUCTION-marked set is exactly the mislabelled set.

dependentEvidence.invocation_effect_refs: NOT LISTED, BY PROOF. Every effect ref carries invocation_id with a tenant-composite FK to governed_action_invocations, so excluding a parent invocation deterministically excludes its declared effects. 8 refs exist hosted; 3 hang off PRODUCTION-marked invocations (af4c9376, 81443af0, 5a99c8f1) and are covered by those three entries.
dependentEvidence.change_ledger: LISTED INDIVIDUALLY, BY PROOF OF THE OPPOSITE. Both PRODUCTION-marked ledger rows have invocation_id IS NULL, so no parent exclusion can reach them.
dependentEvidence.pursuit_participants, context_contributi: LISTED INDIVIDUALLY. None carries an invocation linkage of any kind.

orgScoping: certification_exclusions is org-scoped under FORCEd RLS. A context_grant is visible to both parties, so it is filed once per party; every other subject is filed under its own row's org.
